description: Real-time Google web results: title, URL, date and snippet for each result, plus the AI Overview, answer box, knowledge panel, local pack, ads and "People also ask" when Google shows them. Question-style queries ("how do I...", "what is...") usually get an AI Overview. Each page read is one billed search, so use pages=1 unless you need more. Usually 2-6 s per page. Without an API key, pay per call in USDC on Base with x402 (the first call answers with the price).

country.description: Two-letter country code Google searches from (gl), e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Default "us".

location.description: Search as if from this place, e.g. "Austin, Texas, United States". Leave out for a country-wide search.

pages.description: Result pages to read (about 10 results each), 1-3. Default 1.

query.description: The search, as typed into Google.

time.description: Only results from the past hour, day, week, month or year.

name: google_search
title: Google search
